content.Title: 2022 ACC/AHA Aortic Disease Guideline
Main Topics: Surveillance of Thoracic Aortic Dilation and Aneurysm
Surveillance of Abdominal Aortic Dilation and Aneurysm
Key Points: Statins are recommended for use in AAA patients to potentially reduce aneurysm growth and rupture.
Smoking cessation is strongly recommended to reduce AAA associated risks.
Antithrombotic therapy should be adjusted according to AAA conditions.
Regular imaging and monitoring are advised for both thoracic and abdominal aortic aneurysms.
